event.value: Word came down the roads he built: a man with a book is breaking the ten realms' work into 'shards'. Ornig has built for ten thousand years; he knows what broken irrigation runes look like in a report.

He checked every span and sluice on the north road twice and started stockpiling repair stone. Anything broken can be rebuilt — he believes that — but he is no longer sure the breaking is an accident, and that is the part he cannot fit in his head.

notes: BENCH boss — no meeting yet; this is the dread of a builder hearing that someone breaks things on purpose. All dimensions shallow. His flaw is load-bearing here: he believes anything broken can be rebuilt, which makes him slow to understand the protagonist keeps breaking things on purpose — hence 'bracing-builder', a man checking his work against a storm he refuses to believe in. His profile's canChangeCondition is the hope in the file: if the hero ever puts the hammer down and picks up a trowel, Ornig would teach him, and means it. Note he suspects (not knows) that the 'shards' are domestic magic. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
